summary: If bit 0 of the flag byte at (this+0x1C) is set, append the dword at (this+0x18) into global array dword_7CC9CC indexed by counter dword_7CD07C, then increment the counter. Returns whether the counter is still below 8 (buffer not full). The audio-source interpretation is carried from existing analysis and is unconfirmed.

operations.description: Bit 0 of byte at (this+0x1C) must be set for the source to be collected; otherwise the entry is skipped.
Store the dword at (this+0x18) into dword_7CC9CC[dword_7CD07C] (array write at current counter index).
Read current counter dword_7CD07C into a temp, then increment dword_7CD07C by 1 (counter advances).
Return (unsigned int)dword_7CD07C < 8, i.e. true while the collected-source counter has not reached the 8-entry capacity.
